title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Administration Center Tool

facts.text: Business Central Administration Tool is an MMC snap-in for creating and managing server instances.
Only administrator group members on the computer can use the tool.
Install via setup by choosing Server Option or Administration Tool under custom options.
Run from Start menu or open MMC and add the Business Central snap-in.
Left pane shows server computers and instances; center pane displays instance settings or status.
Right pane shows available actions; Windows PowerShell History pane lists equivalent commands for tasks performed.
